versions.why: First version, restarted on 2026-11-12 when the early measurements were deleted: review and text mode, per-model request profile, a second try after a cut-off review answer, scores over the text without added Markdown marks, num_ctx 8192, long texts in pieces as in the app, answer format 1.

The proofreading exchange (corrected text, explanations, unclear check) joins review and text as an answer mode, and the fingerprint now covers its three requests per language and the knob that turns step 3 off. The request side of review and text mode is unchanged: their part of the fingerprint hashes to version 1's.

Additive: the correct-only answer mode (step 1 of the exchange alone) joins the others, and a profile may carry sampling values (top_k, top_p, min_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, repeat_penalty) besides the temperature; the fingerprint covers a sampled profile. Every request that existed in version 2 hashes as it did (review, text and exchange, every language, profile and text budget), so version 2 runs are re-stamped as version 3 after that check.

Additive: step 1 of the exchange may send a named variant of its system prompt (keep, find, shot; StepProfile.prompt, run --prompt), and the fingerprint covers each variant's text in the exchange and correct-only modes. Every request that existed in version 3 hashes as it did (the version 3 fingerprint is the hash of this one without the three prompt variants, checked on 2026-11-16), so version 3 runs are re-stamped as version 4 after that check. On 2026-11-20 the fingerprint's keys were renamed from the answer modes to the setups they stand for (review -> one-request-review, text -> one-request-text, exchange -> text-first, correct-only -> text-first/correct); every request hashes as it did, checked by renaming the keys back.

Additive: the repair message after an invalid answer names the reason and no longer quotes the rejected answer. Only the repair part of the fingerprint changes; every request hashes as in version 4 (checked on 2026-11-27 by hashing with the old message), so version 4 runs are re-stamped as version 5 when no answer in them was repaired.
